reads.how: An isolated host initialized this exact VST3 processor, captured its default component/controller, and restored the component. Every mapped stored float was changed separately through the public VST3 parameter API at normalized endpoints and 0.25, then its captured value was patched into the initial component and reloaded. Saved values and physical plain-value readback matched; legacy enum normalized values may quantize. This records host-API serialization evidence; Kumi Rust-output reload and DAW acceptance are tracked separately. It does not prove every audible DSP behavior.

native.evidence: Native schemas were inspected outside the repository, converted by the measured slot/name mapping, and loaded through the public VST3 component API into fresh processes. The committed native fixture is synthesized only from initialized component/controller controls; it contains no factory preset content. CI-built Kumi at source revision aa184f6b converted the initialized native fixture with an edit, edited the resulting VST3 file again, and loaded it into a fresh native instance of the version recorded here. Parameter readback, internal preset name and VST3 Name metadata matched. This establishes Rust-codec conversion acceptance; DAW loading and audible DSP behavior are separate checks.
